Implement backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/media/service/MediaStorageService.java only.
- Autowire MediaFileRepository.
- Methods:
  * generatePresignedUpload(Long userId, String fileName, String mimeType, long fileSizeBytes): validates mimeType (JPEG/PNG/WEBP only) and file size (max 25MB), creates MediaFile entity with status 'PENDING', generates unique S3 key (e.g. 'users/' + userId + '/raw/' + UUID.randomUUID() + '_' + fileName), constructs upload URL (pre-signed S3 or secure upload endpoint), returns Map with {mediaId, s3Key, uploadUrl, expiresAt}.
  * confirmUpload(Long mediaId, String sha256Hash): finds MediaFile, sets uploadStatus = 'UPLOADED', sha256Hash = sha256Hash, confirmedAt = Instant.now(), saves and returns MediaFile.
  * getUserMedia(Long userId): returns List<MediaFile> for user.
